name: gimbal_safety_sphere
bound_method: Fixed sphere centre lies on the yaw axis, so yaw preserves radius. Bound only the moving assembly; retain the base plate and yaw stator primitives separately. Transform every current visual mesh vertex and collision box corner into its stage frame. Cylinders use circumscribed 64-sided prisms. For each pitch-subtree point, maximize squared distance analytically over pitch +/-pi/2. For camera points, first take the two extrema of z after roll +/-pi/2; the roll and camera translations are collinear with the roll axis. Evaluate A*cos(pitch)+B*sin(pitch) at both endpoints and its interior minimum. This bounds the full continuous yaw/pitch/roll travel without a triangle-inequality offset or pose sampling. Centre z=0.174 is a rounded one-dimensional minimax fit to the moving swept geometry.
usage: Coarse moving-assembly proxy for arm/environment avoidance. Replace only covers_links with this sphere. Keep the fixed gimbal_base_link mount plate and yaw stator, and the support pole, as their own primitives. Do not count covered bodies twice or use this proxy for internal gimbal self-collision.
excludes: fixed base plate and yaw stator (retain original primitives)
revalidate_on: Any gimbal geometry, joint axis, origin, travel, camera payload or mounting changes. The combined robot rigid base transform may change without invalidating the local bound.
